answer: Use challenge-bound service bonds with rotating peer audits. 1) Each new key locks 64 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 64,000 POA, risks 32,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like a fable climbing to zenith, an onyx seal proves one source; aliases cannot multiply its weight.
